# Excalidraw font assets

Assets are copied unchanged from @excalidraw/excalidraw 0.18.1. Exact upstream WOFF2 files and font source metadata: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/v0.18.1/packages/excalidraw/fonts

The family notice files preserve copyright and license metadata from the actual bundled fonts. OFL text accompanies the OFL families. ComicShanns retains its embedded MIT notice. The legacy Liberation family is GPL-2.0 with the font exception; its original COPYING and License.txt are included. Upstream Liberation source: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-1.7-fonts/tree/main/src

These font licenses are distinct from Excalidraw's MIT code license. Fonts and notices are distributed together under the app's assets and licenses folders.
